newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Banco di Napoli ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Banco di Napoli ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency said on Thursday it affirmed the ratings for Banco di Napoli, at short-term A3, a long-term BBB, individual E and legal rating 2.
The bank is the largest in southern Italy, with market shares of around 20 percent of lending and deposits, IBCA said in a statement.

"Following its huge losses from poor quality lending, Banco di Napoli appointed new senior management and received external support to help with its liquidity difficulties. It is in the process of implementing a plan which is designed to produce a net income for the bank in 1998.

However, almost all the bank's capital has been used to offset the losses. The Italian Treasury has promised ITL2,000 billion in cash to help recapitalise the bank and is currently auctioning 60% of the bank's shares.

Any purchaser will need to provide additional funds to complete the recapitalisation. Costs are still high but are expected to decrease. Although depending on the character of the eventual purchaser, or group of purchasers, IBCA is likely to view positively the support for Banco di Napoli deriving from a new owner."
